source.name: FC Dallas – 'FC Dallas Introduces Children’s Health and UT Southwestern as Official Health Care Partners'
source.quote: announced a multi-year partnership today that will see the North Texas-based health care systems become the exclusive health care and hospital partners of FC Dallas

note: Multi-year partnership announced 11 January 2023: Children's Health on the primary jersey, UT Southwestern Medical Center on the secondary. No reported deal value found; the release does not give one.
